question: Describe your experience with version control systems.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: I use Git daily with feature branches and pull requests. In my last project, I established a branching strategy: main for production, develop for integration, feature branches for new work. I use rebase for clean history and squash commits before merging. I also review PRs and provide constructive feedback.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, git, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-A role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
What would you do differently next time?
